content: In order to facilitate the transformation, we design the irony reward as the difference between the irony score of the input sentence and that of the output sentence. Formally, when we input a non-ironic sentence INLINEFORM0 and transfer it to an ironic sentence INLINEFORM1 , our irony reward is defined as: DISPLAYFORM0
